quiz.question: Which check belongs before the first context load?

choices.text: The kind of the target record.

hints.text: A native doubleword load needs the documented alignment.
The file has already been validated, but this call still admits its own native arguments.

quiz.question: Why is target eight invalid for eight frames?

choices.text: A target must be a multiple of four.
The valid indices are zero through seven.
Only full-frame indices may be requested.

hints.text: Count and last valid index differ by one.
Use a strict unsigned less-than comparison for the target.

quiz.question: Which value must remain fixed during the backward search?

hints.text: A search position changes; the requested result does not.
Saved registers survive the record routine when both functions follow the ABI.

quiz.question: What does a directory entry represent?

choices.text: A byte offset from this file base.

hints.text: Native storage order and the meaning of a stored integer are separate matters.
Prove that sixteen header bytes remain before forming the record window.

quiz.question: Why inspect record kinds instead of rounding by the period?

choices.text: Every delta contains a hidden full image.
Extra full frames are permitted between required ones.
The period is a byte offset.

hints.text: The period guarantees an upper bound on the backward distance.
The first full record encountered while walking backward is the nearest one.

quiz.question: Which expected sequence belongs to a seek starting at full frame four?

hints.text: The record header retains its original file sequence number.
Use a private record context so intermediate successes cannot publish final seek state.

quiz.question: What supplies the end of the last record window?

choices.text: An unused directory entry after the frame count.

hints.text: There is no directory entry after the last accepted frame.
Check order before subtracting two unsigned offsets.

quiz.question: Where should a replayed full frame be written before the target is complete?

hints.text: An individual record success is earlier than whole-seek success.
Check the nested status before advancing the replay index.

quiz.question: How many records are replayed from start four through target six?

hints.text: Both endpoints are included.
Test a target that is itself a full frame: it still requires one application.

quiz.question: Why does this vector copy need no RGB packing shuffle?

choices.text: Scratch already contains native display words.
Byte order never matters in a framebuffer.
Each source byte is a separate pixel.

hints.text: The earlier record routine already constructed each numeric color.
There are 16,384 bytes divided by sixteen bytes per vector.

quiz.question: What does the replay count measure?

choices.text: Applied records, including the starting full frame.
All directory entries in the file.

hints.text: The final metadata describes this successful seek.
Retain earlier output fields on failure rather than clearing them.
